chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
"Escort your brides at night and serve food in the morning."

key_terms.عَرَائِسَكُمْ: Your brides; women being taken to marriage

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام teach about the etiquette of wedding processions and serving food?
ai.summary: This hadith gives guidance regarding wedding customs and timing. It recommends that brides be escorted at night and that food be served in the morning, reflecting etiquette and social practice connected to marriage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4403 - It is narrated by Al-Sakooni from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Escort your brides at night and serve food in the morning."
